mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project_outbox_events (event_id, occurred_at, topic, ordering_key, event_snapshot, traceparent, next_attempt_at) VALUES (CAST(#{eventId} AS uuid), #{occurredAt}, #{topic}, CAST(#{orderingKey} AS uuid), CAST(#{payload} AS jsonb), #{traceparent}, #{occurredAt})
mapper.select: WITH candidate AS ( SELECT current.event_id FROM project_outbox_events current WHERE current.published_at IS NULL AND current.next_attempt_at <= #{at} AND (current.claimed_until IS NULL OR current.claimed_until <= #{at}) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_outbox_events earlier WHERE earlier.ordering_key = current.ordering_key AND earlier.published_at IS NULL AND (earlier.occurred_at, earlier.event_id) < (current.occurred_at, current.event_id)) ORDER BY current.occurred_at, current.event_id FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1 ) UPDATE project_outbox_events event SET claim_token = CAST(#{token} AS uuid), claimed_until = #{until}, attempt_count = attempt_count + 1 FROM candidate WHERE event.event_id = candidate.event_id RETURNING event.event_id::text AS event_id, event.topic, event.ordering_key::text AS ordering_key, event.event_snapshot::text AS payload, event.traceparent, event.claim_token::text AS claim_token, event.attempt_count
mapper.update: UPDATE project_outbox_events SET published_at = #{at}, claim_token = NULL, claimed_until = NULL, last_failure = NULL WHERE event_id = CAST(#{eventId} AS uuid) AND claim_token = CAST(#{token} AS uuid) AND published_at IS NULL

UPDATE project_outbox_events SET next_attempt_at = #{at}, claim_token = NULL, claimed_until = NULL, last_failure = #{failure} WHERE event_id = CAST(#{eventId} AS uuid) AND claim_token = CAST(#{token} AS uuid) AND published_at IS NULL
